天成元年七月二十七日

claims.assessment: since the founding fought a hundred hard battles; fame for might and strategy shakes barbarian and Chinese alike; Ye rebels would be easy if given sole command
used deceitful words to escape Ye

sourceDate.text: 丁酉，淮南楊溥遣使賀平蜀

claims.assessment: a son like this; the Li will not perish
people's hearts greatly pleased; foundation of kingship laid

sourceDate.text: 詔東北面副招討使李紹真率兵討之

zh.exact: 東北面副招討使李紹真

sourceDate.text: 命宋州節度使元行欽率騎三千赴鄴都招撫
丁未，鄴都行營招撫使元行欽率諸道之師再攻鄴都

claims.assessment: long favored and relied upon by the emperor

units.zh: 同光四年春正月戊午朔，帝不受朝賀，契丹寇渤海。
units.en: On the wuwu new moon in spring of Tongguang 4, Cunxu skipped New Year court; Khitan forces raided Bohai.
units.literal: Spring, first month, wuwu new moon, Tongguang year 4: the Emperor did not accept court congratulations; the Khitan raided Bohai.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔以去歲災沴，物價騰踴，自今月三日後避正殿，減膳撤樂，以答天譴。
units.en: On renxu an edict blamed last year's disasters for soaring prices and ordered him to leave the main hall, cut meals, and stop music from the third of the month to appease heaven.
units.literal: On renxu an edict said that because of last year's disasters and calamities prices had soared; from the third day of this month onward he would avoid the main hall, reduce meals, and withdraw music, to answer heaven's reproach.

units.zh: 應去年遭水災州縣，秋夏稅賦並與放免。
units.en: Autumn and summer taxes were waived for every county flooded last year.
units.literal: For prefectures and counties that had suffered flood disaster last year, autumn and summer tax levies were all remitted.

units.zh: 自壬午年已前所欠殘稅，及諸色課利，已有敕命放免者，尚聞所在卻有征收，宜令租庸司切準前敕處分。
units.en: Tax arrears before renwu and levies already remitted by edict were still being collected locally; the Zuyong Office was told to enforce the earlier order.
units.literal: Arrears of residual tax owed before the renwu year, and various kinds of levies and profits, though already remitted by edict, were still heard to be collected in places; the Zuyong Office was ordered strictly to handle matters according to the prior edict.

units.zh: 應京畿內人戶，有停貯斛斗者，並令減價出糶；
units.en: Capital households hoarding grain were ordered to sell at reduced prices;
units.literal: For households within the capital region who were hoarding grain in store, all were ordered to sell at reduced price;

units.zh: 如不遵行，當令檢括。
units.en: refusal would bring investigation and seizure.
units.literal: if they did not comply, investigation and seizure were to be ordered.

units.zh: 西川王衍父子及偽署將相官吏，除已行刑憲外，一切釋放。
units.en: Wang Yan of Shu, his son, and Shu's puppet ministers and officials were freed except those already executed.
units.literal: Wang Yan of Shu, father and son, and the falsely appointed generals, ministers, and officials, except those already punished under criminal law, were all released.

units.zh: 天下禁囚，除十惡五逆、官典犯贓、屠牛毀錢、放火劫舍、持刀殺人，準律常赦不原外，應合抵極刑者，遞降一等。
units.en: Prisoners nationwide except capital crimes, corruption, cattle-slaughter, coin-breaking, arson, robbery, and blade murder had death sentences cut one grade where statute allowed.
units.literal: Among prisoners under ban throughout the realm, aside from the ten abominations, five capital crimes, official corruption, slaughtering cattle and destroying coin, arson and robbery, and murder with a blade—cases not normally pardoned by statute—those who should have received the extreme penalty had it reduced one grade.

units.zh: 其餘罪犯悉與減降；
units.en: all other offenders received further reductions;
units.literal: all other criminals were likewise reduced and lowered;

units.zh: 逃背軍健，並放逐便。
units.en: deserters were banished outright.
units.literal: deserter soldiers were all banished as convenient.

units.zh: 癸亥，河中節度使李繼麟來朝。
units.en: On guihai Li Jilin, military governor of Hezhong, presented himself at court.
units.literal: On guihai Hezhong military commissioner Li Jilin came to court.

units.zh: 諸州上言，準宣為去年十月地震，集僧道起消災道場。
units.en: Prefectures reported ritual grounds for last October's earthquake, per edict.
units.literal: The various prefectures reported that, according to an edict for the earthquake of last year's tenth month, monks and Daoists were gathered to establish disaster-averting ritual grounds.

units.zh: 甲子，魏王繼岌殺樞密使郭崇韜於西川，夷其族。
units.en: On jiazi Jiji killed Guo Chongtao in Shu and wiped out his family.
units.literal: On jiazi Prince of Wei Jiji killed Privy Council commissioner Guo Chongtao in Shu and exterminated his clan.

units.zh: 丙寅，百官上表，請復常膳，凡三上表，乃允之。
units.en: On bingyin officials petitioned three times before Cunxu resumed regular meals.
units.literal: On bingyin the hundred officials memorialized asking that regular meals be resumed; they memorialized three times before it was granted.

units.zh: 西川行營都監李廷安進西川樂官二百九十八人。
units.en: Li Ting'an of the Shu campaign staff sent 298 Shu musicians to court.
units.literal: Li Ting'an, overall monitor of the Shu campaign force, presented two hundred ninety-eight Shu music officers.

units.zh: 契丹寇女真、渤海。
units.en: Khitan forces raided Jurchen and Bohai.
units.literal: The Khitan raided Jurchen and Bohai.

units.zh: 戊寅，契丹阿保機遣使貢良馬。
units.en: On wuyin Abaoji sent fine horses as tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin the Khitan Abaoji sent envoys presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 庚辰，帝異母弟鄜州節度使存乂伏誅。
units.en: On gengchen Cunxu's half-brother Cunyi, commissioner of Fuzhou, was beheaded.
units.literal: On gengchen the Emperor's younger half-brother, Fuzhou military commissioner Cunyi, was executed by beheading.

units.zh: 存乂，郭崇韜之子婿也，故亦及於禍。
units.en: Cunyi had married Guo Chongtao's daughter, so he fell with the Guo clan.
units.literal: Cunyi was Guo Chongtao's son-in-law; hence he too met disaster.

units.zh: 是日，以河中節度使、守太師、兼尚書令、西平王李繼麟為滑州節度使，尋令朱守殷以兵圍其第，誅之，夷其族。
units.en: That day Li Jilin, military governor of Hezhong, acting Grand Mentor, concurrently Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Xiping, was made military governor of Hua Prefecture. Soon Zhu Shouyin was ordered to surround his residence with troops, execute him, and exterminate his clan.
units.literal: That day Hezhong military commissioner, Guardian Grand Mentor, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Xiping Li Jilin was made Huazhou military commissioner; soon Zhu Shouyin was ordered to surround his residence with troops, execute him, and exterminate his clan.

units.zh: 辛巳，吐渾、奚各遣使貢馬。
units.en: On xinsi Tuyuhun and Xi envoys brought horses.
units.literal: On xinsi the Tuyuhun and Xi each sent envoys presenting horses.

units.zh: 鎮州上言，部民凍死者七千二百六十人。
units.en: Zhen reported 7,260 freeze deaths among its people.
units.literal: Zhenzhou reported that among its people seven thousand two hundred sixty had frozen to death.

units.zh: 又奏，準宣進花果樹栽及抽樂人梅審譯赴京。
units.en: It also sent fruit trees and the musician Mei Shenyi to the capital, per edict.
units.literal: It also memorialized that, according to edict, fruit-flower trees were to be presented and the musician Mei Shenyi escorted to the capital.

units.zh: 甲申，以鄆州節度使、永王存霸為河中節度使，以滑州節度使、申王存渥為鄆州節度使。
units.en: On jiashen Cunba of Yan became Hezhong commissioner and Cunwo of Hua became Yan commissioner.
units.literal: On jiashen Yanzhou military commissioner and Prince of Yong Cunba was made Hezhong military commissioner; Huazhou military commissioner and Prince of Shen Cunwo was made Yanzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 乙酉，內人景姹上言：「昭宗遇難之時，皇屬千餘人同時遇害，為三穴瘞於宮城西古龍興寺北，請改葬。」
units.en: On yiyou, the palace woman Jing Cha submitted a report: "When Emperor Zhaozong met his end, more than a thousand members of the imperial clan were killed at the same time and buried in three pits north of the old Longxing Temple, west of the palace city. I request that they be reburied."
units.literal: On yiyou palace woman Jing Cha reported: "When Zhaozong met disaster, more than a thousand imperial kin were killed at once and buried in three pits north of the old Longxing Temple west of the palace city; we ask that they be reburied."

units.zh: 從之，仍詔河南府監護其事。
units.en: Approved, with Henan ordered to oversee the reburial.
units.literal: It was approved, and Henan prefecture was still ordered to oversee the matter.

units.zh: 丙戌，回鶻可汗阿咄欲遣使貢良馬。
units.en: On bingxu the Uyghur qaghan Aduoyu sent envoys to present fine horses.
units.literal: On bingxu the Uyghur qaghan Aduoyu sent envoys presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 鎮州上言，平棘等四縣部民，餓死者二千五十人。
units.en: Zhen said 2,050 had starved in Pingji and four neighboring counties.
units.literal: Zhenzhou reported that among the people of Pingji and four other counties two thousand fifty had starved to death.

units.zh: 丁亥，詔朱友謙同惡人史武等七人，已當國法，並籍沒家產。
units.en: On dinghai an edict confiscated the estates of Zhu Youqian's seven accomplices, including Shi Wu, already executed.
units.literal: On dinghai an edict said Zhu Youqian's fellow evildoers Shi Wu and six others had already met state law and all family property was to be confiscated.

units.zh: 武等友謙舊將，時皆為刺史，並以無罪族誅。
units.en: Wu and the others had been Youqian's generals and serving prefects, yet were killed with their clans though innocent.
units.literal: Wu and the rest were Youqian's old generals; at the time all were prefects, yet all were clan-executed though guiltless.

units.zh: 〈（《歐陽史》，丁亥，殺李繼麟之將史武、薛敬容、周唐殷、楊師太、王景、來仁、白奉國。）〉
units.en: (The 《Ouyang History》 dates dinghai: Shi Wu, Xue Jingrong, Zhou Tangyin, Yang Shitai, Wang Jing, Lai Ren, and Bai Fengguo, Li Jilin's generals, were executed.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Ouyang History》 records dinghai: Li Jilin's generals—Shi Wu, Xue Jingrong, Zhou Tangyin, Yang Shitai, Wang Jing, Lai Ren, and Bai Fengguo—were executed.)〉

units.zh: 二月己丑，以宣徽南院使、知內侍省兼內勾、特進、右領軍衛上將軍李紹宏為驃騎大將軍、守左武衛上將軍、知內侍省，充樞密使。
units.en: On jichou in the second month Li Shaohong of the Xuanhui Court became Flying Cavalry General, Privy Council commissioner, and palace domestic director.
units.literal: Second month, jichou: Palace Attendant of the Southern Xuanhui Court, director of the Palace Domestic Service with concurrent inner liaison, Special Advancement, and Right Leading General Li Shaohong was made Flying Cavalry General, Guardian Left Martial Guard General, director of the Palace Domestic Service, and Privy Council commissioner.

units.zh: 甲午，以鄭州刺史李紹奇為河陽節度使，以樂人景進為銀青光祿大夫、檢校右散騎常侍、守御史大夫。
units.en: On jiawu Li Shaoqi of Zheng became Heyang commissioner; the actor Jing Jin became Silver-Glitter grand master and acting censor-in-chief.
units.literal: On jiawu Zhengzhou prefect Li Shaoqi was made Heyang military commissioner; the musician Jing Jin was made Silver-Glitter Grand Master of Splendid Culture, acting Right Regular Cavalry Attendant, and Guardian Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 進以俳優嬖幸，善采訪閭巷鄙細事以啟奏，復密求妓媵以進，恩寵特厚。
units.en: Favored as a comic actor, Jing Jin reported street gossip, secretly procured women for the palace, and won extraordinary favor.
units.literal: Jin, favored as a comic actor, was skilled at gathering vulgar neighborhood details for memorials, and again secretly sought singing girls to present; favor was especially thick.

units.zh: 魏州錢穀諸務，及招兵市馬，悉委進監臨。
units.en: He supervised Weizhou taxes, recruitment, and horse purchases.
units.literal: Weizhou's grain taxes and all affairs, and recruiting soldiers and buying horses, were all entrusted to Jin to supervise.

units.zh: 孔謙附之以希寵，常呼為「八哥」。
units.en: Kong Qian flattered him and called him "Eighth Brother."
units.literal: Kong Qian attached himself to win favor and commonly called him "Eighth Brother."

units.zh: 諸軍左右無不托附，至於士人，亦有因之而求仕進者。
units.en: Soldiers and even scholars curried favor through him for posts.
units.literal: None in the armies left and right failed to seek patronage; even among scholars some sought advancement through him.

units.zh: 每入言事，左右紛然屏退，惟以陷害熒惑為意焉。
units.en: When he spoke at court attendants were cleared away while he schemed to entrap rivals.
units.literal: Whenever he entered to speak on affairs the attendants all withdrew in disorder; he aimed only to entrap and bewitch.

units.zh: 是日，帝幸冷泉校獵。
units.en: That day Cunxu hunted at Lengquan.
units.literal: That day the Emperor visited Lengquan to hunt.

units.zh: 乙未，宰臣豆盧革上言，請支州縣官實俸，以責課效。
units.en: On yiwei Dou Luge asked that local officials be paid full salaries to enforce performance.
units.literal: On yiwei chief minister Dou Luge memorialized asking that prefectural and county officials receive full salary to enforce performance.

units.zh: 丙申，武德使史彥瓊自鄴馳報稱：「今月六日，貝州屯駐兵士突入都城，剽劫坊市。」
units.en: On bingshen Shi Yanqiong raced from Ye to report Beizhou garrison troops had stormed the city on the sixth and looted the markets."
units.literal: On bingshen Wude commissioner Shi Yanqiong galloped from Ye to report: "On the sixth of this month soldiers garrisoned at Beizhou burst into the capital and plundered the wards and markets."

units.zh: 初，帝令魏博指揮使楊仁晸率兵戍瓦橋，至是代歸，有詔令駐於貝州。
units.en: Yang Renjian's Weibo troops, recalled from Waqiao, had been ordered to camp at Beizhou.
units.literal: Earlier the Emperor had ordered Weibo commander Yang Renjian to lead troops to garrison Waqiao; by now they were relieved and an edict ordered them to stay at Beizhou.

units.zh: 上歲天下大水，十月鄴地大震，自是居人或有亡去他郡者，每日族談巷語云：「城將亂矣！」
units.en: After last year's floods and Ye's tenth-month earthquake, some residents fled; daily rumor said, "The city will revolt!"
units.literal: Last year the realm had great floods; in the tenth month Ye had a great earthquake; since then some residents had fled to other prefectures; daily in lanes and clansmen's talk they said, "The city is about to fall into chaos!"

units.zh: 人人恐悚，皆不自安。
units.en: and fear spread through the city.
units.literal: Everyone was fearful and none felt secure.

units.zh: 十二月，以戶部尚書王正言為興唐尹、知留守事。
units.en: In the twelfth month Wang Zhengyan of Revenue became Xingtang prefect and regent.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Minister of Revenue Wang Zhengyan was made Xingtang prefect and acting regent.

units.zh: 正言年耄風病，事多忽忘，比無經治之才。
units.en: Aged and ill, Zhengyan forgot duties and could not govern.
units.literal: Zhengyan was aged and wind-sick; he often forgot affairs and lacked talent for steady governance.

units.zh: 武德使史彥瓊者，以伶官得幸，帝待以腹心之任，都府之中，威福自我，正言以下，皆脅肩低首，曲事不暇。
units.en: Shi Yanqiong, commissioner of Wude, had won favor as an actor, and the emperor entrusted him as an intimate. Within the capital prefecture, authority and favor issued from him alone; Wang Zhengyan and those below him all hunched their shoulders and bowed their heads, too busy currying favor to do anything else.
units.literal: Wude commissioner Shi Yanqiong had won favor as an actor; the Emperor treated him with inner-trust duty; within the capital prefecture authority and blessing issued from himself alone—Zhengyan and those below all hunched shoulders and bowed heads, currying favor without pause.

units.zh: 由是政無統攝，奸人得以窺圖。
units.en: Government collapsed and plotters moved freely.
units.literal: Hence government lacked coordination and villains could plot.

units.zh: 洎郭崇韜伏誅，人未測其禍始，皆云：「崇韜已殺繼岌，自王西川，故盡誅郭氏。」
units.en: After Guo Chongtao's death rumor said he had killed Jiji and seized Shu, so the Guo clan was wiped out."
units.literal: When Guo Chongtao was executed people had not yet gauged how the disaster began; all said, "Chongtao had already killed Jiji and made himself king of Shu—hence the Guo clan was wholly executed."

units.zh: 先是，有密詔令史彥瓊殺朱友謙之子澶州刺史建徽。
units.en: A secret edict had ordered Shi Yanqiong to kill Zhu Youqian's son Jianhui, prefect of Chan.
units.literal: Earlier there had been a secret edict ordering Shi Yanqiong to kill Zhu Youqian's son Jianhui, prefect of Chanzhou.

units.zh: 史彥瓊夜半出城，不言所往。
units.en: Shi Yanqiong rode out at midnight without saying where.
units.literal: Shi Yanqiong left the city at midnight, saying nothing of where he went.

units.zh: 詰旦，閽報正言曰：「史武德夜半馳馬而去，不知何往。」
units.en: At dawn the gate officer told Zhengyan that Shi Yanqiong had fled at midnight."
units.literal: At dawn the gate officer reported to Zhengyan: "Wude Shi galloped away at midnight—we do not know where."

units.zh: 是日人情震駭，訛言云：「劉皇后以繼岌死於蜀，已行弑逆，帝已晏駕，故急征彥瓊。」
units.en: Rumor spread that Empress Liu had murdered Cunxu after Jiji's death in Shu, explaining Shi Yanqiong's midnight ride."
units.literal: That day popular feeling was shaken; false rumor said, "Empress Liu, because Jiji had died in Shu, had already committed regicide; the Emperor had already passed—hence Yanqiong was urgently summoned."

units.zh: 其言播於鄴市，貝州軍士有私寧親於都下者，掠此言傳於貝州。
units.en: The tale reached Beizhou through soldiers visiting kin in Ye.
units.literal: The words spread through Ye's markets; Beizhou soldiers who had kin in the capital carried the tale back to Beizhou.

units.zh: 軍士皇甫暉等因夜聚蒱博不勝，遂作亂，劫都將楊仁晸曰：「我輩十有餘年為國家效命，甲不離體，已至吞並天下，主上未垂恩澤，翻有猜嫌。
units.en: Soldiers Huangfu Hui and others, after losing at night gambling, mutinied and seized commander Yang Renjian, saying, "For more than ten years we have served the state, never taking armor from our bodies, until the realm was conquered; yet the sovereign has shown us no grace and instead suspects us.
units.literal: Soldiers Huangfu Hui and others, having lost at night gambling, then made rebellion and seized commander Yang Renjian, saying, "We have served the state more than ten years, armor never off our bodies, until the realm was swallowed up—yet the sovereign has not bestowed grace and instead harbors suspicion.

units.zh: 防戍邊遠，經年離阻鄉國，及得代歸，去家咫尺，不令與家屬相見。
units.en: After years on distant frontiers, cut off from home, when they were finally relieved and came within a stone's throw of home, they were still denied even a glimpse of their families.
units.literal: Guarding distant frontiers, separated from home for years, and on relief returning home was within a foot—yet we were not allowed to see kin.

units.zh: 今聞皇后弑逆，京邑已亂，將士各欲歸府寧親，請公同行。」
units.en: Now we hear the Empress has committed regicide and the capital is in chaos; the soldiers all wish to return home to see their families. Please, sir, go with us."
units.literal: Now we hear the Empress committed regicide and the capital is in chaos; the troops each wish to return home—please, sir, go with us."

units.zh: 仁晸曰：「汝等何謀之過耶！
units.en: Yang Renjian said, "Your plan is madness!
units.literal: Yang Renjian said, "How excessive is your plotting!

units.zh: 今英主在上，天下一家，從駕精兵不下百萬，西平巴、蜀，威振華夷，公等各有家族，何事如此！」
units.en: Now a brilliant sovereign rules above and the realm is one family. The elite troops following the imperial carriage number no fewer than a million. To the west Ba and Shu have been pacified, awing Chinese and barbarians alike. You gentlemen each have families—why act like this!"
units.literal: Now a brilliant sovereign is above and the realm is one family; the following elite troops are not fewer than a million; to the west Ba and Shu have been pacified, awing China and barbarians—you each have families; why act thus!"

units.zh: 軍人乃抽戈露刃環仁晸曰：「三軍怨怒，鹹欲謀反，苟不聽從，須至無禮。」
units.en: The soldiers drew blades and surrounded Renjian, saying, "The three armies are angry and all wish to rebel; if you do not obey, we shall have to be rude."
units.literal: The soldiers then drew blades and surrounded Renjian, saying, "The three armies are angry and all wish to rebel; if you do not obey, we must be rude."

units.zh: 仁晸曰：「吾非不知此，但丈夫舉事，須計萬全。」
units.en: Renjian said, "I am not unaware of this, but when a man undertakes an affair, he must plan for complete success."
units.literal: Renjian said, "I am not unaware of this—but a man's undertaking must be fully calculated."

units.zh: 軍人即斬仁晸。
units.en: They killed him on the spot.
units.literal: The soldiers at once beheaded Renjian.

units.zh: 裨將趙在禮聞軍亂，衣不及帶，將逾垣而遁，亂兵追及，白刃環之曰：「公能為帥否？
units.en: Lieutenant Zhao Zaili, hearing the army was in chaos, had no time to belt his robe and was about to climb over the wall to flee when the mutineers caught him; blades ringed him and they said, "Can you be commander?
units.literal: Lieutenant Zhao Zaili, hearing the army in chaos, had not time to belt his robe and was about to climb the wall to flee when the mutineers overtook him; blades ringed him and they said, "Can you be commander?

units.zh: 否則頭隨刃落！」
units.en: If not, your head will fall with the blade!"
units.literal: If not, your head follows the blade!"

units.zh: 在禮懼，即曰：「吾能為之。」
units.en: Terrified, Zhao Zaili immediately said, "I can do it."
units.literal: Terrified, Zhao Zaili immediately said, "I can do it."

units.zh: 眾遂呼噪，中夜燔劫貝郡。
units.en: The mutineers shouted and looted Beizhou at midnight.
units.literal: The crowd then shouted and at midnight burned and plundered Beizhou.

units.zh: 詰旦，擁在禮趨臨清，剽永濟、館陶。
units.en: At dawn they marched Zhao Zaili toward Linqing and raided Yongji and Guantao.
units.literal: At dawn they drove Zaili toward Linqing and plundered Yongji and Guantao.

units.zh: 五日晚，有自貝州來者，言亂兵將犯都城，都巡檢使孫鐸等急趨史彥瓊之第，告曰：「賊將至矣，請給鎧仗，登陴拒守。」
units.en: On the fifth evening, someone arrived from Bei Prefecture saying the rebel troops were about to attack the capital; patrol commissioner Sun Duo and others hurried to Shi Yanqiong's residence and told him, "The rebels are about to arrive. Please issue armor and weapons so we can mount the walls and defend them."
units.literal: On the evening of the fifth someone came from Beizhou saying the mutineers would attack the capital; capital patrol commissioner Sun Duo and others hurried to Shi Yanqiong's residence and reported, "The rebels are coming—please issue armor and weapons and mount the walls to defend."

units.zh: 彥瓊曰：「今日賊至臨清，計程六日方至，為備未晚。」
units.en: Shi Yanqiong said, "Today the rebels have reached Linqing; by the route it will be six days before they arrive, so it is not too late to prepare."
units.literal: Yanqiong said, "Today the rebels reach Linqing; by the route it is six days before they arrive—preparation is not yet late."

units.zh: 孫鐸曰：「賊來寇我，必倍道兼行，一朝失機，悔將何及！
units.en: Sun Duo said, "When rebels come to attack us they will surely march by forced stages; if we lose the moment once, what regret will suffice!
units.literal: Sun Duo said, "When rebels come to attack us they surely march by forced stages; lose the moment once and what regret will suffice!

units.zh: 請僕射率眾登陴，鐸以勁兵千人伏於王莽河逆擊之；
units.en: He asked Shi Yanqiong to hold the wall while he ambushed a thousand elite troops at Wangmang River.
units.literal: Please, Vice Director, lead the masses onto the walls; Duo will lie in ambush with a thousand crack troops at Wangmang River to strike them head-on;

units.zh: 賊既挫勢，須至離潰，然後可以剪除。
units.en: A river ambush would break them before they reached the wall.
units.literal: once the rebels' momentum is broken they must scatter—then they can be cut down.

units.zh: 如俟其凶徒薄於城下，必慮奸人內應，則事未可測也。」
units.en: If we wait until the wicked host presses the wall, we must fear traitors within, and then the matter cannot be predicted."
units.literal: If we wait until the wicked host presses the wall, we must fear traitors within—and then the affair cannot be gauged."

units.zh: 彥瓊曰：「但訓士守城，何須即戰。」
units.en: Shi Yanqiong said, "Simply train the soldiers to defend the city. Why must we fight at once?"
units.literal: Yanqiong said, "Only train the men to hold the city—why fight at once."

units.zh: 時彥瓊疑孫鐸等有他誌，故拒之。
units.en: He suspected Sun Duo's motives and rejected the plan.
units.literal: At the time Yanqiong suspected Sun Duo and others of other designs, hence he refused them.

units.zh: 是夜三更，賊果攻北門，彥瓊時以部眾在北門樓，聞賊呼噪，即時驚潰。
units.en: At the third watch rebels hit the north gate; Shi Yanqiong fled from the tower in panic.
units.literal: That night at the third watch the rebels indeed attacked the north gate; Yanqiong was then with his troops on the north gate tower; hearing the rebels' shouts he at once panicked and fled.

units.zh: 彥瓊單騎奔京師。
units.en: He fled alone on horseback to the capital.
units.literal: Yanqiong fled alone on horseback to the capital.

units.zh: 遲明，亂軍入城，孫鐸與之巷戰，不勝，攜其母自水門而出，獲免。
units.en: At dawn mutineers entered; Sun Duo fought in the streets, then escaped with his mother through the water gate.
units.literal: At daybreak the mutineers entered the city; Sun Duo fought them in the lanes but could not win; he took his mother out through the water gate and escaped.

units.zh: 晡晚，趙在禮引諸軍據宮城，署皇甫暉等為都虞候、斬斫使，諸軍大掠。
units.en: By evening Zhao Zaili held the palace, made Huangfu Hui adjutant, and the army looted Ye.
units.literal: In late afternoon Zhao Zaili led the armies to seize the palace city, appointing Huangfu Hui and others overall adjutants and execution officers; the armies plundered greatly.

units.zh: 興唐尹王正言謁在禮，望塵再拜。
units.en: Wang Zhengyan bowed twice in the dust to Zhao Zaili.
units.literal: Xingtang prefect Wang Zhengyan called on Zaili and twice bowed in the dust.

units.zh: 是日，眾推在禮為兵馬留後，草奏以聞。
units.en: That day the mutineers made Zhao Zaili acting commissioner and memorialized court.
units.literal: That day the crowd pushed Zaili as acting military commissioner and drafted a memorial to report it.

units.zh: 帝怒，命宋州節度使元行欽率騎三千赴鄴都招撫，詔征諸道之師進討。
units.en: Cunxu sent Yuan Xingqin of Song with 3,000 horse to pacify Ye and ordered circuit armies to attack.
units.literal: The Emperor in rage ordered Songzhou military commissioner Yuan Xingqin to lead three thousand cavalry to Ye to pacify them, and issued an edict the various circuits' armies to advance for punishment.

units.zh: 丁酉，淮南楊溥遣使賀平蜀。
units.en: On dingyou Yang Pu of Huainan congratulated the Shu victory.
units.literal: On dingyou Huainan's Yang Pu sent envoys congratulating the pacification of Shu.

units.zh: 己亥，魏王繼岌奏，康延孝擁眾反，回寇西川。
units.en: On jihai Jiji reported Kang Yanxiao in revolt and raiding Shu.
units.literal: On jihai Prince of Wei Jiji memorialized that Kang Yanxiao had gathered troops in rebellion and was turning to raid Shu.

units.zh: 遣副招討使任圜率兵追討之。
units.en: Ren Huan was sent to pursue him.
units.literal: Deputy pacification commissioner Ren Huan was sent to lead troops in pursuit.

units.zh: 庚子，福建節度副使王延翰奏，節度使王審知委權知軍府事。
units.en: On gengzi Wang Yanhan reported Wang Shenzhi had left him in charge of Fujian.
units.literal: On gengzi Fujian deputy military commissioner Wang Yanhan memorialized that military commissioner Wang Shenzhi had entrusted him with military government affairs.

units.zh: 邢州左右步直軍四百人據城叛，推軍校趙太為留後，詔東北面副招討使李紹真率兵討之。
units.en: 400 Xingzhou guards rebelled, made Zhao Tai regent, and Li Shaozhen was sent to crush them.
units.literal: Four hundred infantry of Xingzhou's left and right step guards rebelled and seized the city, pushing army officer Zhao Tai as regent; Northeast deputy pacification commissioner Li Shaozhen was issued an edict to lead troops to punish them.

units.zh: 辛丑，元行欽至鄴都，進攻南門，以詔書招諭城中，趙在禮獻羊酒勞軍，登城遙拜行欽曰：「將士經年離隔父母，不取敕旨歸寧，上貽聖憂，追悔何及！
units.en: On xinchou Yuan Xingqin reached Ye, attacked the south gate, and used an edict to summon the city; Zhao Zaili presented sheep and wine to comfort the army and bowed from the wall to Xingqin, saying, "The soldiers have been separated from their parents for years; by returning home without edict, they have burdened the sage with worry. What regret can suffice!
units.literal: On xinchou Yuan Xingqin reached Ye, attacked the south gate, and with an edict summoned the city; Zhao Zaili presented sheep and wine to comfort the army and from the wall bowed distantly to Xingqin, saying, "The troops were separated from parents for years and, not taking the edict to return home, burdened the sage—what regret can suffice!

units.zh: 儻公善為敷奏，俾從渙汗，某等亦不敢不改過自新。」
units.en: If you, sir, will memorialize well and let us follow the edict of grace, we too dare not fail to reform ourselves."
units.literal: If you, sir, will memorialize well and let us follow the edict of grace, we too dare not fail to reform."

units.zh: 行欽曰：「上以汝輩有社稷功，必行赦宥。」
units.en: Xingqin said, "Because you have merit for the altars of state, the sovereign will surely grant pardon."
units.literal: Xingqin said, "The sovereign, because you have merit for the altars of state, will surely grant pardon."

units.zh: 因以詔書諭之。
units.en: He read the edict to the wall.
units.literal: He then used the edict to instruct them.

units.zh: 皇甫暉聚眾大詬，即壞詔。
units.en: Huangfu Hui cursed and tore up the edict.
units.literal: Huangfu Hui gathered the crowd and cursed loudly, then destroyed the edict.

units.zh: 行欽以聞，帝怒曰：「收城之日，勿遺噍類！」
units.en: Cunxu, told, raged: "When the city falls, spare none!"
units.literal: Xingqin reported it; the Emperor in rage said, "On the day the city is taken, leave no mouth!"

units.zh: 壬寅，行欽自鄴退軍，保澶州。
units.en: On renyin Xingqin withdrew to Chan.
units.literal: On renyin Xingqin withdrew from Ye and held Chanzhou.

units.zh: 甲午，從馬直宿衛軍士王溫等五人夜半謀亂，殺本軍使，為衛兵所擒，磔於本軍之門。
units.en: On jiawu five palace guards led by Wang Wen killed their officer at midnight, were caught, and dismembered at the camp gate.
units.literal: On jiawu followers-of-the-horse direct palace guard soldiers Wang Wen and five others plotted rebellion at midnight, killed their army commander, were seized by guards, and were dismembered at their army's gate.

units.zh: 丙午，以右散騎常侍韓彥惲為戶部侍郎。
units.en: On bingwu Han Yanheng became Revenue vice minister.
units.literal: On bingwu Right Regular Cavalry Attendant Han Yanheng was made Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 丁未，鄴都行營招撫使元行欽率諸道之師再攻鄴都。
units.en: On dingwei Yuan Xingqin led circuit armies against Ye again.
units.literal: On dingwei Ye campaign pacification commissioner Yuan Xingqin led the various circuits' armies to attack Ye again.

units.zh: 戊申，以洋州留後李紹文為夔州節度使。
units.en: On wushen Li Shaowen of Yang became Kuizhou commissioner.
units.literal: On wushen Yangzhou regent Li Shaowen was made Kuizhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 詔河中節度使、永王存霸歸藩。
units.en: Cunba of Hezhong, Prince of Yong, was ordered back to his fief.
units.literal: An edict ordered Hezhong military commissioner and Prince of Yong Cunba to return to his fief.

units.zh: 己酉，以樞密使宋唐玉為特進、左威衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使。
units.en: On jiyou Song Tangyu of the Privy Council became Special Advancement, Left Weijun upper general, and Xuanhui southern court commissioner.
units.literal: On jiyou Privy Council commissioner Song Tangyu was made Special Advancement, Left Weijun upper general, and charged as Xuanhui southern court commissioner.

units.zh: 庚戌，諸軍大集於鄴都，進攻其城，不克。
units.en: On gengxu the armies massed at Ye and assaulted the city without success.
units.literal: On gengxu all armies greatly massed at Ye and advanced to attack the city but could not take it.

units.zh: 行欽又大治攻具。
units.en: Yuan Xingqin again prepared siege engines in earnest.
units.literal: Xingqin again greatly prepared siege engines.

units.zh: 城中知其無赦，晝夜為備。
units.en: Knowing there would be no pardon, the city prepared day and night.
units.literal: Within the city, knowing there would be no pardon, day and night they made ready.

units.zh: 朝廷聞之益恐，連發中使促繼岌西征之師。
units.en: The court grew more afraid and sent envoys in succession to hurry Jiji's western army.
units.literal: The court, hearing of it, grew ever more afraid and in succession sent palace envoys to urge Jiji's western campaign army.

units.zh: 繼岌以康延孝據漢州，中軍之士從任圜進討，繼岌端居利州，不獲東歸。
units.en: With Kang Yanxiao holding Hanzhou, Jiji sent the central army under Ren Huan while he stayed at Lizhou and could not return east.
units.literal: Jiji, because Kang Yanxiao held Hanzhou, had the central army follow Ren Yuan to attack; Jiji sat at Lizhou and could not return east.

units.zh: 是日，飛龍使顏思威部署西川宮人至。
units.en: That day Yan Siwei of the Flying Dragon Office brought the Shu palace women in.
units.literal: That day Flying Dragon commissioner Yan Siwei deployed the western Shu palace women to arrive.

units.zh: 辛亥，淮南楊溥遣使貢方物。
units.en: On xinhai Yang Pu of Huainan sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On xinhai Huainan's Yang Pu sent envoys presenting local products.

units.zh: 西京上言，客省使李嚴押蜀主王衍至本府。
units.en: The western capital reported that Li Yan of Guest Reception had brought Shu ruler Wang Yan there.
units.literal: The western capital reported that Guest Reception commissioner Li Yan had escorted Shu ruler Wang Yan to that prefecture.

units.zh: 壬子，以守太尉、中書令、河南尹兼河陽節度使、齊王張全義為檢校太師、兼尚書令，充許州節度使。
units.en: On renzi Zhang Quanyi—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, Henan prefect, and Heyang commissioner—became Grand Preceptor and Secretariat director and took Xu as military commissioner.
units.literal: On renzi Acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, Henan prefect, and concurrent Heyang military commissioner Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi was made Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat director, and charged as Xu military commissioner.

units.zh: 東川董璋奏，準詔誅遂州節度使李令德於本州，夷其族。
units.en: Dong Zhang of Dongchuan reported executing Suizhou commissioner Li Lingde there by edict and wiping out his clan.
units.literal: Dongchuan's Dong Zhang memorialized that per edict he had executed Suizhou military commissioner Li Lingde in that prefecture and exterminated his clan.

units.zh: 癸丑，湖南馬殷奏，福建節度使王審知疾甚，副使王延翰已權知軍府事，請降旄節。
units.en: On guichou Ma Yin of Hunan reported Wang Shenzhi of Fujian gravely ill, Yanhan already running the prefecture, and asked for the commission.
units.literal: On guichou Hunan's Ma Yin memorialized that Fujian military commissioner Wang Shenzhi was gravely ill, deputy Wang Yanhan already held military affairs in the prefecture, and asked that banners and tally be granted.

units.zh: 司天監上言：自二月上旬後，晝夜陰雲，不見天象，自二十六日方晴，至月終，星辰無變。
units.en: Astronomy reported overcast skies from early second month until clearing on the twenty-sixth, with no change in the stars through month's end.
units.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy reported: from early in the second month day and night were overcast and the sky could not be seen; only on the twenty-sixth did it clear; to month's end the stars showed no change.

units.zh: 以右衛上將軍朱漢賓知河南府事。
units.en: Zhu Hanbin of the Right Weijun was made acting Henan prefect.
units.literal: Right Weijun upper general Zhu Hanbin was made acting Henan prefect.

units.zh: 甲辰，命蕃漢總管李嗣源統親軍赴鄴都，以討趙在禮。
units.en: On jiachen Li Siyuan, Han and non-Han overall commander, was sent with the imperial guard to Ye against Zhao Zaili.
units.literal: On jiachen Han and non-Han overall commander Li Siyuan was ordered to lead the imperial guard to Ye to attack Zhao Zaili.

units.zh: 帝素倚愛元行欽，鄴城軍亂，即命為行營招討使，久而無功。
units.en: Cunxu had long favored Yuan Xingqin; when Ye mutinied he made him pacification commissioner, but months passed without success.
units.literal: The Emperor had long relied on and favored Yuan Xingqin; when the Ye army mutinied he at once made him campaign pacification commissioner, but after a long time there was no success.

units.zh: 時趙太據邢州，王景戡據滄州，自為留後，河朔郡邑多殺長吏。
units.en: At the time Zhao Tai held Xing Prefecture and Wang Jingzhan held Cang Prefecture, each making himself acting commissioner; across the Hebei circuits many killed their senior officials.
units.literal: At the time Zhao Tai held Xingzhou and Wang Jingzhan held Cangzhou, each as acting commissioner; in the Hebei circuits many killed their superiors.

units.zh: 帝欲親征，樞密使與宰臣奏言：「 京師者，天下根本，雖四方有變，陛下宜居中以製之，但命將出征，無煩躬禦士伍。」
units.en: Cunxu wished to lead the army himself; the Privy Council and chancellors said, "The capital is the realm's root; though trouble stirs in the four quarters, Your Majesty should stay at the center and only send generals—there is no need to lead the ranks yourself."
units.literal: The Emperor wished to campaign in person; the Privy Council commissioners and chief ministers memorialized, saying, "The capital is the root of All-under-Heaven; though the four quarters have disturbances, Your Majesty should dwell in the center to control them—only order generals to campaign; there is no need to trouble yourself with the ranks."

units.zh: 帝曰：「紹榮討亂未有成功，繼岌之軍尚留巴、漢，餘無可將者，斷在自行。」
units.en: Cunxu said, "Shaorong has not yet put down the revolt, Jiji's army is still in Ba and Han, and no one else can command—I must go myself."
units.literal: The Emperor said, "Shaorong's suppression of the disorder has not yet succeeded, Jiji's army still remains in Ba and Han, and among the rest there is no one who can command— I am determined to go myself."

units.zh: 樞密使李紹宏等奏曰：「陛下以謀臣猛將取天下，今一州之亂而雲無可將者，何也？
units.en: Li Shaohong of the Privy Council said, "Your Majesty won the realm with plotting ministers and fierce generals—how can one prefecture's revolt leave no commander?
units.literal: Privy Council commissioner Li Shaohong and the rest memorialized, saying, "Your Majesty with plotting ministers and fierce generals took the realm—now for disorder in one prefecture you say there is no one who can command—how is that?

units.zh: 總管李嗣源是陛下宗臣，創業已來，艱難百戰，何城不下，何賊不平，威略之名，振於夷夏，以臣等籌之，若委以專征，鄴城之寇，不足平也！」
units.en: Li Siyuan is Your Majesty's clansman; since the founding he has fought a hundred battles—what city did he not take, what bandit did he not pacify—his fame for strategy shakes barbarian and Chinese alike; entrust him with sole command and the Ye rebels are nothing!"
units.literal: Overall commander Li Siyuan is Your Majesty's clansman; since the founding he has fought a hundred hard battles—what city did he not take, what bandit did he not pacify—his name for might and strategy shakes barbarian and Chinese alike; in our reckoning, if entrusted with sole command, the Ye rebels are not enough to be pacified!"

units.zh: 帝素寬大容納，無疑於物，自誅郭崇韜、朱友謙之後，閹宦伶官交相讒諂，邦國大事皆聽其謀，繇是漸多猜惑，不欲大臣典兵，既聞奏議，乃曰：「予恃嗣源侍衛，卿當擇其次者。」
units.en: Cunxu had always been broad and trusting; after Guo Chongtao and Zhu Youqian were killed, eunuchs and actors slandered one another and state affairs went through them—he grew suspicious and would not let great ministers command armies; hearing this he said, "I rely on Siyuan for my guard—choose someone else."
units.literal: The Emperor had always been broad and accommodating and doubted nothing in others; after executing Guo Chongtao and Zhu Youqian, eunuchs and actor-officials in turn slandered one another and the great affairs of the state were all heard at their counsel—thereby he gradually grew suspicious and did not wish great ministers to hold armies; having heard this memorial he said, "I rely on Siyuan for my guard—you should choose another."

units.zh: 又奏曰：「以臣等料之，非嗣源不可。」
units.en: They said again, "In our view only Siyuan will do."
units.literal: They memorialized again, saying, "In our reckoning, none but Siyuan will do."

units.zh: 河南尹張全義亦奏云：「河朔多事，久則患生，宜令總管進兵。
units.en: Zhang Quanyi of Henan also said, "Hebei has many troubles; delay breeds more—order the overall commander forward.
units.literal: Henan prefect Zhang Quanyi also memorialized, saying, "The Hebei has many troubles; if prolonged, trouble will grow—order the overall commander to advance.

units.zh: 如倚李紹榮輩，未見其功。」
units.en: Relying on Li Shaorong and his sort has yet to show results."
units.literal: If one relies on Li Shaorong and his sort, their achievement is not yet seen."

units.zh: 帝乃命嗣源行營。
units.en: Cunxu then put Siyuan in command of the campaign.
units.literal: The Emperor then ordered Siyuan to the campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 是日，延州知州白彥琛奏，綏、銀兵士剽州城謀叛。
units.en: That day Bai Yanchen of Yanzhou reported Suizhou and Yin soldiers raiding the city in planned revolt.
units.literal: That day Yanzhou prefect Bai Yanchen memorialized that Suizhou and Yinzhou soldiers had raided the prefectural city plotting rebellion.

units.zh: 魏王繼岌傳送郭崇韜父子首函至闕下，詔張全義收瘞之。
units.en: Jiji sent Guo Chongtao's and his son's heads in a box to court; Cunxu ordered Zhang Quanyi to bury them.
units.literal: Prince of Wei Jiji forwarded the boxed heads of Guo Chongtao and his son to the court; an edict ordered Zhang Quanyi to receive and bury them.

units.zh: 乙巳，以右武衛上將軍李肅為安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽使，以吏部尚書李琪為國計使。
units.en: On yisi Li Su of the Right Wuwei became salt commissioner for the Anyi and Jie pools; Li Qi of Personnel became state accounts commissioner.
units.literal: On yisi Right Wuwei upper general Li Su was made salt monopoly commissioner for Anyi and Jie counties' two pools; Minister of Personnel Li Qi was made state accounts commissioner.

units.zh: 三月丁未朔，李紹真奏，收復邢州，擒賊首趙太等二十一人，徇於鄴都城下，皆磔於軍門。
units.en: On the dingwei new moon of the third month Li Shaozhen reported Xing retaken and Zhao Tai and twenty-one rebel leaders captured, displayed below Ye's walls, and torn apart at the army gate.
units.literal: Third month, dingwei new moon: Li Shaozhen memorialized that Xingzhou had been recovered and the rebel leaders Zhao Tai and twenty-one others captured; they were displayed below Ye's walls and all torn apart at the army gate.

units.zh: 庚戌，李紹真自邢州赴鄴都城下。
units.en: On gengxu Li Shaozhen came from Xing to below Ye's walls.
units.literal: On gengxu Li Shaozhen came from Xingzhou to below Ye's walls.

units.zh: 辛亥，以威武軍節度副使、福建管內都指揮使、檢校太傅、守江州刺史王延翰為福建節度使，依前檢校太傅。
units.en: On xinhai Wang Yanhan—Weiwu deputy, Fujian commander, acting Grand Preceptor, and acting Jiang prefect—became Fujian commissioner while keeping acting Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On xinhai Weiwu military deputy commissioner, Fujian circuit overall commander, Acting Grand Preceptor, and acting Jiangzhou prefect Wang Yanhan was made Fujian military commissioner, still Acting Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 壬子，李嗣源領軍至鄴都，營於西南隅。
units.en: On renzi Li Siyuan reached Ye and camped at the southwest corner.
units.literal: On renzi Li Siyuan led the army to Ye and camped at the southwest corner.

units.zh: 甲寅，進營於觀音門外，下令諸軍，詰旦攻城。
units.en: On jiayin he moved camp outside Guanyin Gate and ordered an assault at dawn.
units.literal: On jiayin he advanced camp to outside Guanyin Gate and ordered the armies to assault the city at dawn.

units.zh: 是夜，城下軍亂，迫嗣源為帝。
units.en: That night the troops below the walls mutinied and forced Siyuan to be emperor.
units.literal: That night the army below the walls mutinied and forced Siyuan to be emperor.

units.zh: 遲明，亂軍擁嗣源及霍彥威入於鄴城，復為皇甫暉、趙進等所脅，嗣源以詭詞得出，夜分至魏縣。
units.en: At dawn the mutineers pushed Siyuan and Huo Yanwei into Ye, then Huangfu Hui, Zhao Jin, and the rest coerced them again; Siyuan talked his way out and at midnight reached Wei county.
units.literal: At dawn the mutinous army escorted Siyuan and Huo Yanwei into Ye; they were again coerced by Huangfu Hui, Zhao Jin, and the rest; Siyuan with deceitful words got out and at midnight reached Wei county.

units.zh: 時嗣源遙領鎮州，詰旦，議欲歸藩，上章請罪，安重誨以為不可，語在《明宗紀》中。
units.en: Siyuan still held Zhen at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his post and asked punishment; An Chonghui forbade it—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.
units.literal: At the time Siyuan held Zhenzhou at a distance; at dawn he debated returning to his circuit and submitted a memorial asking punishment; An Chonghui held it impossible—the account is in the 《Mingzong Annals》.

units.zh: 翌日，遂次於相州。
units.en: The next day he halted at Xiang.
units.literal: The next day he then halted at Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 元行欽部下兵退保衛州，以飛語上奏，嗣源一日之中遣使上章申理者數四。
units.en: Yuan Xingqin's men fell back to Weizhou and sent rumors aloft; in one day Siyuan sent four envoys pleading his case.
units.literal: Yuan Xingqin's subordinate troops withdrew to defend Weizhou and with flying rumors submitted memorials; within one day Siyuan sent envoys with memorials pleading his case four times.

units.zh: 帝遣嗣源子從審與中使白從訓齎詔以諭嗣源，行至衛州，從審為元行欽所械，不得達。
units.en: Cunxu sent Siyuan's son Congshen and envoy Bai Congxun with an edict; at Weizhou, Xingqin shackled Congshen and they could not pass.
units.literal: The Emperor sent Siyuan's son Congshen and palace envoy Bai Congxun bearing an edict to instruct Siyuan; when they reached Weizhou, Congshen was shackled by Yuan Xingqin and could not get through.

units.zh: 是日，西面行營副招討使任圜奏，收復漢州，擒逆賊康延孝。
units.en: That day Ren Yuan, western deputy pacification commissioner, reported Han retaken and rebel Kang Yanxiao captured.
units.literal: That day western campaign deputy pacification commissioner Ren Yuan memorialized that Hanzhou had been recovered and the rebel Kang Yanxiao captured.

units.zh: 丙辰，荊南高季興上言，請割峽內夔、忠、萬等三州卻歸當道，依舊管係，又請雲安監。
units.en: On bingchen Gao Jixing of Jingnan asked to return Kui, Zhong, and Wan in the Gorges to his circuit and also sought the Yun'an salt office.
units.literal: On bingchen Jingnan's Gao Jixing memorialized, asking to cut off and return the three prefectures of Kui, Zhong, and Wan within the Gorges to his circuit under former jurisdiction, and also asked for the Yun'an salt office.

units.zh: 初，將議伐蜀，詔高季興令率本軍上峽，自收元管屬郡。
units.en: When the Shu campaign was first planned, Gao Jixing was ordered to lead his army up the Gorges and recover his old prefectures.
units.literal: At first, when they were about to discuss attacking Shu, an edict had ordered Gao Jixing to lead his native army up the Gorges and himself recover the prefectures of his former jurisdiction.

units.zh: 軍未進，夔、忠、萬三州已降，季興數請之，因賂劉皇后及宰臣樞密使，內外葉附，乃俞其請。
units.en: Before his army moved, Kui, Zhong, and Wan had surrendered; Jixing kept asking, bribed Empress Liu and the chancellors and Privy Council, and won approval inside and out.
units.literal: The army had not advanced when Kui, Zhong, and Wan had already surrendered; Jixing repeatedly asked for them and therefore bribed Empress Liu and the chief ministers and Privy Council commissioners; inner and outer were of one mind, and his request was granted.

units.zh: 戊午，詔河南府預借今年秋夏租稅。
units.en: On wuwu Henan was ordered to advance this year's autumn and summer taxes.
units.literal: On wuwu an edict ordered Henan prefecture to advance this year's autumn and summer taxes.

units.zh: 時年饑民困，百姓不勝其酷，京畿之民，多號泣於路，議者以為劉盆子復生矣。
units.en: Famine pressed the people beyond bearing; capital folk wailed on the roads; some said Liu Penzi had come again.
units.literal: At the time famine pressed the people; the common folk could not bear the harshness; people of the capital region many wept and wailed on the roads; commentators held that Liu Penzi had been reborn.

units.zh: 庚申，詔潞州節度使孔赴闕，以右龍虎統軍安崇阮權知潞州。
units.en: On gengshen Kong Qing of Luzhou was summoned to court; An Chongruan of the Right Dragon-Tiger was made acting Luzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On gengshen an edict ordered Luzhou military commissioner Kong Qing to come to court; Right Dragon-Tiger overall commander An Chongruan was made acting Luzhou commissioner.

units.zh: 是日，忠武軍節度使、齊王張全義薨。
units.en: That day Zhang Quanyi, Zhongwu commissioner and Prince of Qi, died.
units.literal: That day Zhongwu military commissioner Prince of Qi Zhang Quanyi died.

units.zh: 壬戌，宰臣豆盧革率百官上表，以魏博軍變，請出內府金帛優給將士。
units.en: On renxu Dou Luge led the officials in asking, because of the Weibo mutiny, to take inner-treasury gold and silk for the troops.
units.literal: On renxu chief minister Dou Luge led the hundred officials in a memorial because of the Weibo army's mutiny, asking to take gold and silk from the inner treasury to generously supply the soldiers.

units.zh: 不報。
units.en: There was no reply.
units.literal: There was no reply.

units.zh: 時知星者上言：「客星犯天庫，宜散府藏。」
units.en: Astrologers said, "The guest star violates the Heavenly Storehouse—the treasury should be opened."
units.literal: At the time those who knew the stars reported, "The guest star violates the Heavenly Storehouse—one should disperse the treasury."

units.zh: 又云：「流星犯天棓，主御前有急兵。」
units.en: They also said, "A meteor violates the Heavenly Club—urgent troops before the throne."
units.literal: They also said, "A meteor violates the Heavenly Club—there will be urgent troops before the throne."

units.zh: 帝召宰臣於便殿，皇后出宮中妝奩銀盆各二，並皇子滿哥三人，謂宰臣曰：「外人謂內府金寶無數，向者諸侯貢獻旋供賜與，今宮中有者，妝奩、嬰孺而已，可鬻之給軍。」
units.en: Cunxu called the chancellors to the informal hall; the empress brought out from the palace two dressing cases and two silver basins, together with three imperial sons, including Mange, and said to the ministers, "Outsiders say the inner treasury is endless; tribute went out as fast as it came—now we have only dressing cases and infants—sell them for the army."
units.literal: The Emperor summoned the chief ministers to the informal hall; the empress brought out from the palace two dressing cases and two silver basins, together with three imperial sons, including Mange, and said to the chief ministers, "Outsiders say the inner treasury has countless gold and treasure; when the feudal lords presented tribute it was at once given away in grants—what the palace now has is only dressing cases and infants—sell them to supply the army."

units.zh: 革等惶恐而退。
units.en: Dou Luge and the rest withdrew in fear.
units.literal: Dou Luge and the rest withdrew in fear.

units.zh: 癸亥，以偽置昭武軍節度使林思諤為閬州刺史。
units.en: On guihai false Zhaowu commissioner Lin Si'e was made Lang prefect.
units.literal: On guihai the false-appointed Zhaowu military commissioner Lin Si'e was made Langzhou prefect.

units.zh: 是日，出錢帛給賜諸軍，兩樞密使及宋唐玉、景進等各貢助軍錢幣。
units.en: That day money and silk were issued to the armies; the Privy Council commissioners, Song Tangyu, Jing Jin, and the rest each gave aid money.
units.literal: That day money and silk were issued to bestow on the armies; the two Privy Council commissioners and Song Tangyu, Jing Jin, and the rest each presented money to aid the army.

units.zh: 是時，軍士之家乏食，婦女掇蔬於野，及優給軍人，皆負物而詬曰：「吾妻子已殍矣，用此奚為！」
units.en: Soldiers' families starved while women gleaned in the wild; when bounty reached the troops they shouldered goods and cursed, "Our wives and children are dead—what is this for!"
units.literal: At the time soldiers' households lacked food; women gathered vegetables in the wild; when the soldiers were generously supplied they all shouldered goods and cursed, saying, "Our wives and children have already starved—what use is this!"

units.zh: 甲子，元行欽自衛州率部下兵士歸，帝幸耀店以勞之。
units.en: On jiazi Yuan Xingqin returned from Weizhou with his men; Cunxu went to Yaodian to comfort them.
units.literal: On jiazi Yuan Xingqin came from Weizhou leading his subordinate soldiers in return; the Emperor went to Yaodian to comfort them.

units.zh: 西川輦運金銀四十萬至闕，分給將士有差。
units.en: Four hundred thousand in western Shu gold and silver reached court and was parceled to the troops by rank.
units.literal: The western Shu transport of four hundred thousand in gold and silver reached the court and was distributed to the soldiers in graded shares.

units.zh: 元行欽請車駕幸汴州，帝將發京師，遣中官向延嗣馳詔所在誅蜀主王衍，仍夷其族。
units.en: Yuan Xingqin asked Cunxu to go to Bian; as he was about to leave the capital he sent Xiang Yansi with a flying edict to execute Wang Yan and exterminate his clan.
units.literal: Yuan Xingqin asked that the imperial carriage go to Bianzhou; the Emperor was about to set out from the capital and sent a palace official, Xiang Yansi, with a flying edict to the place to execute Shu ruler Wang Yan and still exterminate his clan.

units.zh: 乙丑，車駕發京師。
units.en: On yichou the imperial carriage left the capital.
units.literal: On yichou the imperial carriage set out from the capital.

units.zh: 戊辰，遣元行欽將騎軍沿河東向。
units.en: On wuchen Yuan Xingqin was sent to lead cavalry east along the river.
units.literal: On wuchen Yuan Xingqin was sent to lead the cavalry east along the river.

units.zh: 壬申，帝至滎澤，以龍驤馬軍八百騎為前軍，遣姚彥溫董之。
units.en: On renshen Cunxu reached Xingze, made eight hundred Dragon-Flight horsemen the vanguard, and put Yao Yanwen in command.
units.literal: On renshen the Emperor reached Xingze and made eight hundred Dragon-Flight horse troops the vanguard, sending Yao Yanwen to command them.

units.zh: 彥溫行至中牟，率所部奔於汴州。
units.en: At Zhongmou Yao Yanwen led his command in flight to Bian.
units.literal: Yanwen reached Zhongmou and led his command in flight to Bianzhou.

units.zh: 時潘瑰守王村寨，有積粟數萬，亦奔汴州。
units.en: Pan Gui held Wang village stockade with tens of thousands in grain and also fled to Bian.
units.literal: At the time Pan Gui held Wang village stockade with tens of thousands in stored grain and also fled to Bianzhou.

units.zh: 是時，李嗣源已入於汴。
units.en: By then Li Siyuan had already entered Bian.
units.literal: At the time Li Siyuan had already entered Bian.

units.zh: 帝聞諸軍離散，精神沮喪，至萬勝鎮即命旋師。
units.en: Hearing the armies had scattered, Cunxu was dispirited; at Wansheng post he ordered an immediate turnback.
units.literal: The Emperor, hearing that the armies had scattered, was dispirited; reaching Wansheng post he at once ordered the army to turn back.

units.zh: 登路旁荒塚，置酒視諸將流涕。
units.en: He climbed a roadside mound, set out wine, and wept before the generals.
units.literal: He ascended a roadside barren mound, set out wine, and gazed at the generals weeping.

units.zh: 俄有野人進雉，因問塚名，對曰：「里人相傳為愁台。」
units.en: Soon a countryman brought a pheasant; the emperor asked the mound's name, and he answered, "The villagers pass down that it is Sorrow Terrace."
units.literal: Soon a countryman brought a pheasant; he therefore asked the mound's name and was answered, "Village folk transmit that it is called Sorrow Mound."

units.zh: 帝彌不悅，罷酒而去。
units.en: Cunxu was all the more displeased, broke off the wine, and left.
units.literal: The Emperor was all the more displeased, stopped the wine, and left.

units.zh: 是夜，次汜水。
units.en: That night he halted at Sishui.
units.literal: That night he halted at Sishui.

units.zh: 初，帝東出關，從駕兵二萬五千，及復至汜水，已失萬餘騎。
units.en: When Cunxu first went east through the pass he had twenty-five thousand men; by Sishui he had lost more than ten thousand horse.
units.literal: At first, when the Emperor went east out of the pass, the accompanying army was twenty-five thousand; when he again reached Sishui, he had already lost more than ten thousand horse.

units.zh: 乃留秦州都指揮使張塘以步騎三千守關。
units.en: He left Zhang Tang of Qin with three thousand foot and horse to hold the pass.
units.literal: He then left Qinzhou overall commander Zhang Tang with three thousand foot and horse to guard the pass.

units.zh: 帝過罌子穀，道路險狹，每遇衛士執兵仗者，皆善言撫之曰：「適報魏王繼岌又進納西川金銀五十萬，到京當盡給爾等。」
units.en: Passing Jar Valley on a narrow road, whenever he met armed guards he comforted them, saying, "Word just came that Jiji has forwarded another fifty thousand in western Shu gold and silver; when it reaches the capital you shall all have it."
units.literal: The Emperor passed Jar Valley; the road was narrow and dangerous; whenever he met guards holding weapons he always spoke kindly to comfort them, saying, "I have just received word that Prince of Wei Jiji has again forwarded fifty thousand in western Shu gold and silver; when it reaches the capital it will all be given to you."

units.zh: 軍士對曰：「陛下賜與大晚，人亦不感聖恩。」
units.en: The soldiers answered, "Your Majesty's gifts come too late—we feel no grace."
units.literal: The soldiers answered, saying, "Your Majesty's grants come too late—men also do not feel the sage grace."

units.zh: 帝流涕而已。
units.en: Cunxu could only weep.
units.literal: The Emperor could only weep.

units.zh: 又索袍帶賜從官，內庫使張容哥對曰：「頒給已盡。」
units.en: He again asked for robes and belts for attending officials; Zhang Rongge of the Inner Treasury said, "Distribution is exhausted."
units.literal: He again asked for robes and belts to bestow on attending officials; Inner Treasury commissioner Zhang Rongge answered, saying, "Distribution is already exhausted."

units.zh: 衛士叱容哥曰：「致吾君社稷不保，是此閹豎！」
units.en: Guards shouted at Rongge, "You cost our lord his state—this eunuch!"
units.literal: The guards shouted at Rongge, saying, "You caused our lord's state not to be preserved— it is this eunuch!"

units.zh: 抽刀逐之，或救而獲免。
units.en: They drew swords and chased him; some saved him and he narrowly escaped.
units.literal: They drew swords to pursue him; some rescued him and he narrowly escaped.

units.zh: 容哥謂同黨曰：「皇后惜物不散，軍人歸罪於吾輩，事若不測，吾輩萬段，願不見此禍。」
units.en: Rongge told his fellows, "The empress hoarded goods and would not give; the soldiers blame us—if things go wrong we are torn in ten thousand pieces—I would rather not see that day."
units.literal: Rongge said to his fellows, "The empress was stingy with goods and would not distribute them; the soldiers put the blame on us—if things go wrong we shall be torn in ten thousand pieces; I would rather not see this calamity."

units.zh: 因投河而死。
units.en: He threw himself into the river and died.
units.literal: He therefore threw himself into the river and died.

units.zh: 〈（《隆平集》：內臣李承進逮事唐莊宗，太祖嘗問莊宗時事，對曰：「莊宗好畋獵，每次近郊，衛士必控馬首曰：『兒郎輩寒冷，望陛下與救接。』
units.en: (The 《Longping Collection》 says inner attendant Li Chengjian long served Zhuangzong; Taizu once asked about his reign and he said, "Zhuangzong loved the hunt; each time he neared the suburbs guards seized the bridle and said, 'Lads, we are cold—grant relief.'
units.literal: (The 《Longping Collection》 records: inner attendant Li Chengjian long served Tang Zhuangzong; Taizu once asked about Zhuangzong's affairs, and he answered, saying, "Zhuangzong loved hunting; each time he went near the suburbs the guards would surely seize the horse's head and say, 'You lads are cold— we hope Your Majesty will grant relief.'

units.zh: 莊宗隨所欲給之，如此者非一。
units.en: Zhuangzong gave whatever they wanted—not once or twice.
units.literal: Zhuangzong would grant whatever they desired—there were not just one or two such cases.

units.zh: 晚年蕭牆之禍，由賞賚無節，威令不行也。」
units.en: The late palace calamity came from boundless rewards and commands that would not run."
units.literal: The calamity within the palace walls in his later years came from rewards without measure and orders that would not go forth."

units.zh: 太祖歎曰：「二十年夾河戰爭，不能以軍法約束此輩，誠兒戲。」）〉
units.en: Taizu sighed, "Twenty years of war on both banks of the river, yet military law could not bind them—child's play."）〉
units.literal: Taizu sighed and said, "Twenty years of war on both banks of the river, yet one could not restrain these fellows with military law— truly child's play."）〉

units.zh: 甲戌，次石橋，帝置酒野次，悲啼不樂，謂元行欽等諸將曰：「鄴下亂離，寇盜蜂起，總管迫於亂軍，存亡未測，今訛言紛擾，朕實無聊。
units.en: On jiaxu he halted at Stone Bridge; Cunxu set wine in the wild and wept, telling Yuan Xingqin and the rest, "Below Ye there is disorder and bandits swarm; Siyuan is pressed by mutineers and may live or die; rumors stir and I am at a loss.
units.literal: On jiaxu he halted at Stone Bridge; the Emperor set out wine in the wild and wept without joy, saying to Yuan Xingqin and the other generals, "Below Ye there is disorder and bandits swarm; the overall commander is pressed by the mutinous army and life or death is not yet known; now rumors stir and I am truly at a loss.

units.zh: 卿等事餘已來，富貴急難，無不共之，今茲危蹙，賴爾籌謀，而竟默默無言，坐觀成敗。
units.en: You have shared fortune and hardship with me without exception; now in danger I rely on your plans, yet you sit silent and watch.
units.literal: You have served me in fortune and hardship and shared all without exception; now in this danger I rely on your plans, yet in the end you are silent without words and sit watching success or failure.

units.zh: 予在滎澤之日，欲單騎渡河，訪求總管，麵為方略，招撫亂軍，卿等各吐胸襟，共陳利害，今日俾餘至此，卿等如何！」
units.en: At Xingze I wished to cross alone to find Siyuan, lay plans face to face, and win the mutineers—you should each speak your mind on harm and benefit; today you have brought me here—what of you!"
units.literal: When I was at Xingze I wished to cross the river alone on horseback to seek the overall commander, lay out plans face to face, and win over the mutinous army—you each should speak your breast and together state harm and benefit; today you have brought me to this—what of you!"

units.zh: 元行欽等百餘人垂泣而奏曰：「臣本小人，蒙陛下撫養，位極將相，危難之時，不能立功報主，雖死無以塞責，乞申後效，以報國恩。」
units.en: Yuan Xingqin and more than a hundred wept and said, "We were petty men Your Majesty raised to general and minister; in danger we cannot repay you—though we die we cannot fulfill our charge; let us show later merit for the state's grace."
units.literal: Yuan Xingqin and more than a hundred others wept as they memorialized, saying, "We were originally petty men whom Your Majesty raised; our posts reach general and minister; in time of danger we cannot establish merit to repay our lord—though we die we cannot fulfill our charge; we beg to show later effect to repay the state's grace."

units.zh: 於是餘人皆援刀截發，置髻於地，以斷首自誓，上下無不悲號，識者以為不祥。
units.en: The rest drew knives, cut their hair, laid their topknots on the ground, and swore to cut off their own heads; all wailed; observers called it ill-omened.
units.literal: Then the rest all drew knives, cut their hair, placed their topknots on the ground, and swore to cut off their own heads; above and below none did not wail; those who knew held it inauspicious.

units.zh: 是日，西京留守張筠部署西征兵士到京，見於上東門外，晡晚，帝還宮。
units.en: That day Zhang Yun of the western capital brought the western campaign troops to the upper east gate; in late afternoon Cunxu returned to the palace.
units.literal: That day western capital regent Zhang Yun deployed the western campaign soldiers to reach the capital; they were seen outside the upper east gate; in late afternoon the Emperor returned to the palace.

units.zh: 初，帝在汜水，衛兵散走，京師恐駭不寧，及帝至，人情稍安。
units.en: At Sishui the guards had scattered and the capital was afraid; when Cunxu returned, feeling calmed somewhat.
units.literal: At first, when the Emperor was at Sishui, the guards scattered and the capital was fearful and unsettled; when the Emperor arrived, human sentiment was slightly calmed.

units.zh: 乙亥，百官進名起居。
units.en: On yihai the hundred officials presented themselves in audience.
units.literal: On yihai the hundred officials advanced their names in audience.

units.zh: 安義節度使孔奏，點校兵士防城，準詔運糧萬石，進發次。
units.en: Kong Qing of Anyi reported mustering troops for defense and, by edict, moving ten thousand shi of grain in stages.
units.literal: Anyi military commissioner Kong Qing memorialized that he had mustered soldiers to defend the city and, per edict, was transporting ten thousand shi of grain and advancing in stages.

units.zh: 時已殺監軍使據城，詭奏也。
units.en: By then he had killed the army monitor and held the city—it was a false report.
units.literal: By then he had already killed the army monitor and held the city— a false memorial.

units.zh: 丙子，樞密使李紹宏與宰相豆盧革、韋說會於中興殿之廊下，商議軍機，因奏：「魏王西征兵士將至，車駕且宜控汜水，以俟魏王。」
units.en: On bingzi Li Shaohong met Dou Luge and Wei Shuo in the Zhongxing corridor and said, "Jiji's western troops are near—the carriage should hold at Sishui to await him."
units.literal: On bingzi Privy Council commissioner Li Shaohong met with chancellors Dou Luge and Wei Shuo in the corridor below the Zhongxing Hall and discussed military affairs; they therefore memorialized, "Prince of Wei Jiji's western campaign soldiers are about to arrive—the imperial carriage should for the moment hold Sishui to await the Prince of Wei."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: Approved.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 午時，帝出上東門親閱騎軍，誡以詰旦東幸，申時還宮。
units.en: At noon Cunxu went out the upper east gate to review the cavalry and told them to march east at dawn; at shen he returned to the palace.
units.literal: At the noon hour the Emperor went out the upper east gate to personally review the cavalry, admonishing them that at dawn the next day they would travel east; at the shen hour he returned to the palace.

units.zh: 四月丁丑朔，以永王存霸為北都留守，申王存渥為河中節度使。
units.en: On the dingchou new moon of the fourth month Prince Yong Cunba became northern capital regent and Prince Shen Cunwo Hezhong commissioner.
units.literal: Fourth month, dingchou new moon: Prince of Yong Cunba was made northern capital regent and Prince of Shen Cunwo was made Hezhong military commissioner.

units.zh: 是日，車駕將發京師，從駕馬軍陳於宣仁門外，步兵陳於五鳳門外。
units.en: That day, as the court prepared to leave the capital, escort cavalry formed outside Xuaren Gate and infantry outside Wufeng Gate.
units.literal: That day the imperial carriage was about to depart the capital; the escort horse army deployed outside Xuaren Gate, the foot soldiers outside Wufeng Gate.

units.zh: 帝內殿食次，從馬直指揮使郭從謙自本營率所部抽戈露刃，至興教門大呼，與黃甲兩軍引弓射興教門。
units.en: While the Emperor dined in the inner palace, Guo Congqian, commander of the Direct Horse Corps, led his troops from camp with drawn swords to Xingjiao Gate, shouting; the Yellow Armor armies shot at the gate.
units.literal: While the Emperor was at a meal in the inner hall, Guo Congqian, commander of the Direct Horse Corps, led his men from camp with bared blades to Xingjiao Gate shouting; with the Yellow Armor two armies he drew bows and shot at Xingjiao Gate.

units.zh: 帝聞其變，自宮中率諸王近衛禦之，逐亂兵出門。
units.en: Hearing the mutiny, the Emperor led princes and palace guards out to fight and drove the rebels from the gate.
units.literal: The Emperor heard of the mutiny, led princes and close guards from the palace to resist, and drove the rebel troops out the gate.

units.zh: 既而焚興教門，緣城而入，登宮牆歡噪，帝御親軍格鬥，殺亂兵數百。
units.en: They soon burned Xingjiao Gate, scaled the wall, and cheered from the palace ramparts; the Emperor fought with his personal guard and killed hundreds of rebels.
units.literal: Soon they burned Xingjiao Gate, climbed in along the wall, mounted the palace ramparts shouting in joy; the Emperor led his personal guard in hand-to-hand combat and killed several hundred rebels.

units.zh: 俄而帝為流矢所中，亭午，崩於絳霄殿之廡下，時年四十三。
units.en: Soon a stray arrow struck the Emperor; at noon he died under the eaves of Jiangxiao Hall, aged forty-three.
units.literal: Soon the Emperor was struck by a stray arrow; at noon he died under the colonnade of Jiangxiao Hall, aged forty-three.

units.zh: 〈（《琬琰集》載《宋實錄·王全斌傳》云：同光末，蕭牆有變，亂兵逼宮城，近臣宿將，皆釋甲潛遁，惟全斌與符彥卿等十數人居中拒戰。
units.en: (The 《Collected Writings》 cites the 《Song Veritable Records · Wang Quanbin Biography》: at the end of Tongguang, palace mutiny drove rebels against the capital; close ministers and veteran generals shed armor and fled; only Quanbin, Fu Yanqing, and a dozen others held the center to fight.
units.literal: (The 《Collected Writings》 records the 《Song Veritable Records · Wang Quanbin Biography》 as saying: at the end of Tongguang, turmoil rose within the palace walls; rebel troops pressed the palace city; close ministers and veteran generals all doffed armor and fled in secret; only Quanbin and Fu Yanqing and more than ten others held the center to resist.

units.zh: 莊宗中流矢，扶掖歸絳霄殿，全斌慟哭而去。
units.en: Zhuangzong was hit by a stray arrow and was helped back to Jiangxiao Hall; Quanbin wept and withdrew.
units.literal: Zhuangzong was struck by a stray arrow; they supported him back to Jiangxiao Hall; Quanbin wept and left.

units.zh: 《東都事略·符彥卿傳》云：郭從謙之亂，莊宗左右皆引去，惟彥卿力戰，殺十餘人。
units.en: The 《Outline of the Eastern Capital · Fu Yanqing Biography》 says that in Guo Congqian's revolt Zhuangzong's attendants all fled; only Yanqing fought hard and killed more than ten men.
units.literal: The 《Outline of the Eastern Capital · Fu Yanqing Biography》 says: at Guo Congqian's rebellion Zhuangzong's attendants all withdrew; only Yanqing fought fiercely and killed more than ten.

units.zh: 莊宗崩，彥卿慟哭而去。）〉
units.en: When Zhuangzong died, Yanqing wept and left.)〉
units.literal: When Zhuangzong died Yanqing wept and left.)〉

units.zh: 是時，帝之左右例皆奔散，唯五坊人善友斂廓下樂器簇於帝屍之上，發火焚之。
units.en: By then the Emperor's attendants had all scattered; only Shan You of the Five Workshops piled court instruments on the body and burned them.
units.literal: At this time the Emperor's attendants all fled as a rule; only Shan You of the Five Workshops gathered instruments from below the hall colonnade, piled them on the imperial corpse, and set fire.

units.zh: 及明宗入洛，止得其燼骨而已。
units.en: When Mingzong entered Luoyang, only charred bones were found.
units.literal: When Mingzong entered Luoyang only charred bones remained.

units.zh: 天成元年七月丁卯，有司上諡曰光聖神閔孝皇帝，廟號莊宗。
units.en: In the seventh month of Tiancheng 1, on dingmao, the offices proposed the posthumous title Radiant Sagely Spirit Compassionate Filial Emperor and the temple name Zhuangzong.
units.literal: Tiancheng year 1, seventh month, dingmao: the relevant offices submitted the posthumous title Radiant Sagely Spirit Compassionate Filial Emperor, temple name Zhuangzong.

units.zh: 是月丙子，葬於雍陵。
units.en: That month, on bingzi, he was buried at Yong Mausoleum.
units.literal: That month on bingzi he was buried at Yong Mausoleum.

units.zh: 〈（《五代史補》：莊宗之嗣位也，志在渡河，但恨河東地狹兵少，思欲百練其眾，以取必勝於天下，乃下令曰：「凡出師，騎軍不見賊不許騎馬，或步騎前後已定，不得越軍分以避險惡。
units.en: (The 《Supplement to the Five Dynasties History》 says Zhuangzong, on taking the throne, meant to cross the river but found Hedong too small and weak; he wanted iron discipline for certain victory and ordered: "On campaign, cavalry may not mount until they see the enemy; once ranks are set, no unit may break away to dodge hardship.
units.literal: (The 《Supplement to the Five Dynasties History》: when Zhuangzong succeeded the throne his ambition was to cross the river, but he regretted that Hedong's land was narrow and troops few; he wished to drill his forces a hundredfold to win the world for certain, and issued an order: "Whenever troops march out, cavalry may not mount until they see the enemy; once foot and horse front and rear are set they may not leave their unit divisions to avoid hardship.

units.zh: 其分路並進，期會有處，不得違晷刻。
units.en: Separate columns must meet at the appointed place on time.
units.literal: When columns advance by separate routes they must rendezvous at the fixed place and may not miss the hour.

units.zh: 並在路敢言病者，皆斬之。」
units.en: Anyone who complains of illness on the march is executed."
units.literal: Anyone on the march who dares speak of illness—all are executed."

units.zh: 故三軍懼法而戮力，皆一以當百，故朱梁舉天下而不能禦，卒為所滅，良有以也。
units.en: The armies feared the law and fought as one, each man worth a hundred; Liang mustered the realm yet could not stop him and was destroyed—there was reason in it.
units.literal: Thus the three armies feared the law and exerted united strength, each man worth a hundred; thus Liang mustered all under heaven yet could not withstand him and in the end was destroyed by him—well there was reason.

units.zh: 初，莊宗為公子，雅好音律，又能自撰曲子詞。
units.en: As heir, Zhuangzong loved music and wrote his own song lyrics.
units.literal: At first, when Zhuangzong was heir-apparent, he loved music deeply and could compose tune lyrics himself.

units.zh: 其後凡用軍，前後隊伍皆以所撰詞授之，使揭聲而唱，謂之「御製」。
units.en: Later, on every campaign, front and rear units sang the lyrics he wrote aloud—they called them "imperial compositions."
units.literal: Thereafter whenever he used troops, front and rear companies all received his composed lyrics to hold up voices and sing—they called them "imperial composition."

units.zh: 至於入陣，不論勝負，馬頭才轉，則眾歌齊作。
units.en: Even in battle, win or lose, when the horses wheeled the men sang together.
units.literal: Even entering battle, win or lose, as soon as the horse's head turned the crowd sang together.

units.zh: 故凡所鬥戰，人忘其死，斯亦用軍之一奇也。
units.en: In every fight men forgot death—a singular way to use troops.
units.literal: Thus in every fight men forgot death—this too was a marvel in using troops.

units.zh: 莊宗好獵，每出，未有不蹂踐苗稼。
units.en: Zhuangzong loved the hunt; every outing trampled crops.
units.literal: Zhuangzong loved hunting; every outing trampled seedling grain without exception.

units.zh: 一旦至中牟，圍合，忽有縣令，忘其姓名，犯圍諫曰：「大凡有國家者，當視民如赤子，性命所係。
units.en: Once at Zhongmou, when the beat closed, a magistrate whose name is lost broke through and said, "Whoever holds a state should treat the people as infants, for their lives depend on it.
units.literal: Once at Zhongmou, when the hunt ring closed, suddenly a magistrate, name forgotten, broke the ring and remonstrated: "Generally whoever has a state should treat the people like infants—their lives are bound up with it.

units.zh: 陛下以一時之娛，恣其蹂踐，使比屋囂然動溝壑之慮，為民父母，豈其若是耶！」
units.en: Your Majesty tramples the fields for sport and fills every house with fear of ruin—as parent to the people, how can this be right!"
units.literal: Your Majesty for momentary pleasure lets them be trampled at will, making every household alarmed with fear of the ditch—as father and mother to the people, how can it be so!"

units.zh: 莊宗大怒，以為遭縣令所辱，遂叱退，將斬之。
units.en: Zhuangzong flew into a rage, took it as an insult, shouted him off, and was about to kill him.
units.literal: Zhuangzong was greatly angered, thinking the magistrate had insulted him, shouted him away, and was about to execute him.

units.zh: 伶官鏡新磨者，知其不可，乃與群伶齊進，挽住令，佯為詬責曰：「汝為縣令，可以指麾百姓為兒，既天子好獵，即合多留閑地，安得縱百姓耕鋤皆遍，妨天子鷹犬飛走耶！
units.en: The actor Jing Xinmo knew better; he and the whole troupe rushed in, seized the magistrate, and pretended to scold him: "You are magistrate—you may order the people about; if the Son of Heaven loves hunting you should leave open ground—how dare you let farmers plow everywhere and block the royal hawks and hounds!
units.literal: The actor Jing Xinmo knew this would not do, and with the whole troupe advanced together, seized the magistrate, and feigned scolding: "You are magistrate—you can command the people as children; since the Son of Heaven loves hunting you should leave much idle land—how dare you let the people plow everywhere and hinder the Son of Heaven's hawks and hunting dogs from flying and running!

units.zh: 而又不能自責，更敢咄咄，吾知汝當死罪。」
units.en: You will not blame yourself yet yap on—I know you deserve death."
units.literal: And you cannot blame yourself yet dare cluck further—I know you deserve death."

units.zh: 諸伶亦皆嘻笑繼和，於是莊宗默然，其怒少霽，頃之，恕縣令罪。
units.en: The actors laughed along; Zhuangzong fell silent, his anger eased, and he soon pardoned the magistrate.
units.literal: The actors all laughed and chimed in; Zhuangzong fell silent, his rage eased somewhat, and soon forgave the magistrate.

units.zh: 《五代史闕文》：莊宗嘗因博戲，睹骰子采有暗相輪者，心悅之，乃自置暗箭格，凡博戲並認采之在下者。
units.en: The 《Lost Text of the Five Dynasties History》 says Zhuangzong once at dice saw a hidden linked pattern and was pleased; he made "dark arrow" rules so only the bottom face counted.
units.literal: The 《Lost Text of the Five Dynasties History》: Zhuangzong once at dice play saw die faces with dark linked wheels and was pleased; he personally set "dark arrow" rules—at all games only the bottom face counted.

units.zh: 及同光末，鄴都兵亂，從謙以兵犯興教門，莊宗禦之，中流矢而崩。
units.en: At the end of Tongguang the Ye garrison mutinied; Congqian attacked Xingjiao Gate; Zhuangzong resisted, was struck by a stray arrow, and died.
units.literal: By the end of Tongguang the Ye capital troops mutinied; Congqian with troops assaulted Xingjiao Gate; Zhuangzong resisted, was struck by a stray arrow, and died.

units.zh: 識者以為暗箭之應。）〉
units.en: The knowing called it the omen of the dark arrow.)〉
units.literal: The knowing took it as the response of the dark arrow.)〉

units.zh: 史臣曰：莊宗以雄圖而起河、汾，以力戰而平汴、洛，家仇既雪，國祚中興，雖少康之嗣夏配天，光武之膺圖受命，亦無以加也。
units.en: The historian writes: Zhuangzong rose with heroic purpose from the Yellow and Fen rivers and by force pacified Bian and Luo; he avenged his house and revived the dynasty—even Shaokang's restoring Xia to match Heaven and Guangwu's receiving the mandate could not surpass it.
units.literal: The historian writes: Zhuangzong with heroic design rose from He and Fen, by force of arms pacified Bian and Luo; family revenge was avenged and the state fortune revived—though Shaokang restored Xia to match Heaven and Guangwu received the mandate, nothing could be added.

units.zh: 然得之孔勞，失之何速？
units.en: Yet he won it only with great labor—how quickly he lost it!
units.literal: Yet gaining it was very toilsome—how fast to lose?

units.zh: 豈不以驕於驟勝，逸於居安，忘櫛沐之艱難，徇色禽之荒樂。
units.en: Was it not pride after swift victory, ease in peace, forgetting the hardship of rule, and indulgence in women, wine, and sport?
units.literal: Was it not pride in swift victory, ease in settled peace, forgetting comb-and-bath hardship, indulging lust and fowl in wasteful pleasure?

units.zh: 外則伶人亂政，內則牝雞司晨。
units.en: Outside, actors threw government into chaos; inside, the hen ruled the dawn.
units.literal: Without, actors disordering government; within, the hen crowing at dawn.

units.zh: 靳吝貨財，激六師之憤怨；
units.en: He hoarded wealth and goods and provoked the six armies' wrath;
units.literal: Stingily hoarding goods and wealth, provoking the six armies' wrath;

units.zh: 征搜輿賦，竭萬姓之脂膏。
units.en: he levied carts and taxes and drained the people's substance.
units.literal: levying carts and taxes, draining the myriad people's fat and grease.

units.zh: 大臣無罪以獲誅，眾口吞聲而避禍。
units.en: Great ministers died though innocent; the people fell silent to escape harm.
units.literal: Great ministers were executed though guiltless; common mouths swallowed sound to avoid calamity.

units.zh: 夫有一於此，未或不亡，矧咸有之，不亡何待！
units.en: One such fault brings ruin—how much more when all were present? What ruin could wait for?
units.literal: To have one of these and not perish—how much less when all were present; if not to perish, what was left to wait for!

units.zh: 靜而思之，足以為萬代之炯誡也。
units.en: Calm reflection shows a warning bright enough for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: Calmly considered, it suffices as a blazing warning for ten thousand generations.

units.zh: 辛未，武安軍節度使馬殷進封楚王。
units.en: On xinwei Ma Yin, governor of the Wu'an Army, was advanced to King of Chu.
units.literal: On xinwei, Ma Yin, military governor of the Wu'an Army, was advanced and enfeoffed as King of Chu.

units.zh: 辛丑，契丹遣使來告哀，言國主安巴堅以今年七月二十七日卒。
units.en: On xinchou Khitan envoys announced mourning for ruler Ambaqian, who had died on the twenty-seventh of the seventh month.
units.literal: On xinchou the Khitan sent envoys to announce mourning, saying their ruler Ambaqian had died on the twenty-seventh of the seventh month this year.

units.zh: 青州奏，得登州狀申，契丹先攻逼渤海國，自安巴堅身死，雖已抽退，尚留兵馬在渤海扶餘城，今渤海王弟領兵馬攻圍扶餘城內契丹次。
units.en: Qingzhou relayed Dengzhou's report: the Khitan had attacked Bohai; after Abaoji died they pulled back but left troops at Fuyu; the Bohai king's brother now besieged the Khitan there.
units.literal: Qingzhou reported that Dengzhou had memorialized: the Khitan had first pressed Bohai; since An Ba Jian's death they had withdrawn but still left troops at Bohai's Fuyu city; now the Bohai king's brother led troops besieging the Khitan camp within Fuyu city.

units.zh: 契丹王世預歡盟，禮交聘問，遽聞凶訃，倍軫悲懷，可輟今月十九日朝參。」
units.en: The Khitan had long exchanged envoys; hearing of Ambaqian's death, Mingzong suspended court on the nineteenth."
units.literal: The Khitan ruler for generations has cherished alliance and ritual exchange of envoys; suddenly hearing this bereavement, Our grief is doubled—court attendance on the nineteenth of this month may be suspended."

units.zh: 丙午，以荊南節度使、守中書令、渤海王高季興依前檢校太師、兼尚書令，封南平王；
units.en: On bingwu Gao Jixing of Jingnan kept acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Imperial Secretariat and was made Prince of Nanping;
units.literal: On bingwu, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Secretariat Director, and Prince of Bohai Gao Jixing remained acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;

units.zh: 時李嗣源總帳下親軍攻東北隅；
units.en: Li Siyuan led the household guard against the northeast corner;
units.literal: Li Siyuan commanded the personal troops below the tent attacking the northeast corner;

units.zh: 李嗣源壞夾城東北隅，率先掩擊，梁軍大恐，南向而奔，投戈委甲，噎塞行路，斬萬餘級，獲其將副招討使符道昭洎大將三百人，芻粟百萬。
units.en: Li Siyuan breached Jiacity's northeast and charged in; Liang panicked and fled south, shedding arms until the road jammed; over ten thousand were killed; Fu Daozhao and three hundred officers were taken, with a million bundles of fodder.
units.literal: Li Siyuan broke the northeast corner of Jiacity and led the assault; the Liang army was greatly terrified and fled south, casting weapons and armor; the road was choked; more than ten thousand were beheaded; deputy pacification commissioner Fu Daozhao and three hundred great generals were captured, and a million measures of fodder.

units.zh: 五月辛未朔，晨霧晦暝，帝率親軍伏三垂崗下。
units.en: At the xinwei new moon in the fifth month, thick morning fog hid Cunxu's personal troops below Sanchui Ridge.
units.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, morning fog dark and dim, the Emperor led his personal army in ambush below Sanchui Ridge.

units.zh: 以樞密使安重誨為檢校司空，守左領軍大將軍，依前充樞密使。
units.en: An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works and Left Leading Infantry General while keeping the Privy Council post.
