units.literal: Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Minister of Works, held as Left Leading Infantry General, and continued as before as Privy Council commissioner.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：明宗初登位，四方書奏，多令樞密使安重誨讀之，不曉文義。
units.en: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 says when Mingzong first reigned, An Chonghui read most frontier memorials but lacked literary training.
units.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 records: when Mingzong first took the throne, memorials from the four directions were mostly read by Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui, who did not understand literary meaning.

units.zh: 戊寅，以樞密使安重誨兼領襄州節度使。
units.en: On wuyin An Chonghui was also named Xiangzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On wuyin, Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was additionally made Xiangzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 戊戌，樞密使安重誨加檢校太保，行兵部尚書事如故。
units.en: On wuxu An Chonghui became acting grand guardian while keeping acting War minister.
units.literal: On wuxu, Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Grand Guardian and continued to act as Minister of War.

units.zh: 製下，重誨之黨謂重誨曰：「襄州地控要津，不可乏帥，無宜兼領。」
units.en: When the decree issued, his allies told An Chonghui Xiangzhou was too strategic to hold with the Privy Council."
units.literal: When the decree was issued, Chonghui's faction said to Chonghui: "Xiangzhou controls a strategic ford and cannot lack a commander—it is not fitting to hold concurrently."

units.zh: 重誨即自陳退，許之。
units.en: He asked to step down and Mingzong agreed.
units.literal: Chonghui at once memorialized to withdraw; it was approved.

units.zh: 殷求援於淮夷，偽吳楊溥遣大將朱瑾領眾赴援，鄩逆擊破之。
units.en: Yin called on the Huai; Yang Pu of Wu sent Zhu Jin to his aid; Xun routed the relief force.
units.literal: Yin sought aid from the Huai barbarians; false Wu ruler Yang Pu sent the great general Zhu Jin with troops to relieve him; Xun met and broke them.

units.zh: 四月，帝召德威軍歸晉陽。
units.en: In the fourth month Cunxu recalled Zhou Dewei to Jinyang.
units.literal: In the fourth month the Emperor recalled Dewei's army to Jinyang.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》引《莊宗實錄》云：汴軍至蒙坑，周德威逆戰，敗之，斬首三百級，楊師厚退保絳州。
units.en: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 quotes the 《Veritable Records of Zhuangzong》: at Mengkeng Zhou Dewei beat Bian, took three hundred heads, and Yang Shihou fell back to Jiangzhou.
units.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》 cites the 《Veritable Records of Zhuangzong》: Bian troops reached Mengkeng; Zhou Dewei met them in battle, defeated them, beheaded three hundred, Yang Shihou withdrew to hold Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 帝知其無備，乃謂將佐曰：「汴人聞我有喪，必謂不能興師，人以我少年嗣位，未習戎事，必有驕怠之心。
units.en: Knowing them slack, Cunxu told his staff, "Bian will think mourning bars a campaign and a boy on the throne means no soldiering—they will grow proud and lazy.
units.literal: The Emperor, knowing they were unprepared, told his officers: "Bian men hearing our mourning will think we cannot march; seeing a youth succeed they will think me untrained in war and grow arrogant and slack.

units.zh: 初，唐龍紀元年，帝才五歲，從武皇校獵於三垂崗，崗上有明皇原廟在焉。
units.en: Long ago, in Tang Longji 1, five-year-old Cunxu hunted Sanchui Ridge with Wuhuang, where Minghuang's shrine stood.
units.literal: Earlier, in Tang Longji year 1, the Emperor was five; he accompanied Wuhuang hunting at Sanchui Ridge, where the original shrine of Minghuang stood.

units.zh: 六月，鳳翔李茂貞、邠州楊崇本合四川王建之師五萬，以攻長安，遣使會兵於帝，帝遣張承業率師赴之。
units.en: In the sixth month Li Maozhen of Fengxiang and Yang Chongben of Bin with fifty thousand of Wang Jian's Shu attacked Chang'an and asked Cunxu to join; he sent Zhang Chengye.
units.literal: In the sixth month Fengxiang's Li Maozhen and Binzhou's Yang Chongben with Sichuan's Wang Jian's army of fifty thousand attacked Chang'an and sent envoys to join armies with the Emperor; the Emperor sent Zhang Chengye with troops to answer.

units.zh: 九月，邠、岐、蜀三鎮復大舉攻長安，遣李嗣昭、周德威將兵三萬攻晉州以應之。
units.en: In the ninth month Bin, Qi, and Shu struck Chang'an again; Cunxu sent Li Sizhao and Zhou Dewei with thirty thousand against Jinzhou in reply.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Bin, Qi, and Shu three commands again mounted a great attack on Chang'an and sent Li Sizhao and Zhou Dewei with thirty thousand troops to attack Jinzhou in response.

units.zh: 八月，帝御軍南征，先遣周德威、李存審、丁會統大軍出陰地關，攻晉州，為地道，壞城二十餘步，城中血戰拒守。
units.en: In the eighth month Cunxu marched south, sending Zhou Dewei, Li Cunshen, and Ding Hui through Yindi Pass on Jinzhou with tunnels that breached twenty paces of wall—yet the city fought bloodily on.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Emperor personally led the army south, first sending Zhou Dewei, Li Cunshen, and Ding Hui commanding a great army out Yindi Pass to attack Jinzhou, digging a tunnel and breaking the wall more than twenty paces; inside the city they fought bloody battle to hold.

units.zh: 武皇引滿，捋須指帝曰：「老夫壯心未已，二十年後，此子必戰於此。」
units.en: Wuhuang drank his fill, tugged his beard, pointed at Cunxu and said, "I am not done yet—in twenty years this boy will fight here."
units.literal: Wuhuang filled his cup, stroked his beard, pointed at the Emperor and said: "My old ambition is not spent—in twenty years this child will surely fight here."

units.zh: 若簡練兵甲，倍道兼行，出其不意，以吾憤激之眾，擊彼驕惰之師，拉朽摧枯，未雲其易，解圍定霸，在此一役。」
units.en: Drill hard, march fast, and strike unawares—our angry troops against their lazy ones will snap them like rotten wood; relief and empire turn on this fight."
units.literal: If we drill arms and march at double pace by surprise, with our angry inspired host against their arrogant slack army, pulling rotten timber and crushing dry stalks is not called hard; raising the siege and fixing hegemony lies in this one campaign."

units.zh: 甲子，軍發自太原。
units.en: On jiazi the host left Taiyuan.
units.literal: On jiazi the army set out from Taiyuan.

units.zh: 詰旦，天復昏霧，進軍直抵夾城。
units.en: At dawn fog returned; they marched straight on Jiacity.
units.literal: At dawn fog returned; they advanced straight to Jiacity.

units.zh: 帝遂班師於晉陽，告廟飲至，賞勞有差。
units.en: Cunxu returned to Jinyang, feasted the ancestors, and rewarded the army by rank.
units.literal: The Emperor then withdrew the army to Jinyang, reported at the ancestral temple with a feast of drink-to, and rewarded by rank.

units.zh: 乃下令於國中，禁賊盜，恤孤寡，征隱逸，止貪暴，峻堤防，寬獄訟，期月之間，其俗丕變。
units.en: He banned brigandage, aided widows and orphans, sought recluses, curbed greed and cruelty, heightened dikes, and eased lawsuits—and within a month the realm changed.
units.literal: He then ordered within the state: prohibit bandits, pity orphans and widows, recruit hidden worthies, stop greedy violence, heighten dikes and defenses, ease prison litigation—in a month customs greatly changed.

units.zh: 帝每出，於路遇饑寒者，必駐馬而臨問之，由是人情大悅，王霸之業，自茲而基矣。
units.en: Whenever he rode out and met the cold and hungry he stopped to ask after them; hearts warmed, and his kingship took root.
units.literal: Whenever the Emperor went out and met cold and hungry on the road he always halted his horse and inquired; therefore people's hearts were greatly pleased, and the foundation of kingship was laid from then.

units.zh: 梁祖聞其敗也，既懼而歎曰：「生子當如是，李氏不亡矣！
units.en: Hearing the defeat, Liang's founder sighed in fear, "A son like that—and the Li will not die!
units.literal: The Liang founder heard of the defeat, was afraid, and sighed: "To have a son like this—the Li family will not perish!

units.zh: 己卯，以宣義軍節度副大使、知節度事、北面行營副招討等使、特進、檢校太傅霍彥威為天平軍節度副大使，知節度事。
units.en: On jimao, Huo Yanwei—deputy commissioner of Xuanyi, acting military commissioner, deputy northern pacification commissioner, specially advanced, and honorary Grand Mentor—was named deputy commissioner of Tianping with charge of military affairs.
units.literal: On jimao, Xuanyi Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner, Northern Line deputy pacification commissioner, specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor Huo Yanwei was made Tianping Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner.

units.zh: 貞明三年春正月戊午，以前淄州刺史高允奇為右羽林統軍。
units.en: On wuwu in the first month of Zhenming 3, Gao Yunqi, former Inspector of Zi Prefecture, was appointed commander of the Right Feathered Forest.
units.literal: On wuwu, in the first month of spring of Zhenming 3, former Zi Prefecture Inspector Gao Yunqi was made commander of the Right Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 《通鑒》云：李紹榮欲奔河中就永王存霸，從兵稍散，存霸亦率眾千人棄鎮奔晉陽。
units.en: The Comprehensive Mirror adds that Li Shaorong meant to flee to Hezhong to reach Prince Yong Cunba, but his followers slowly melted away, and Cunba too abandoned his command with a thousand men and fled to Jinyang.
units.literal: The Comprehensive Mirror states: Li Shaorong wished to flee to Hezhong to join Prince Yong Cunba; his followers gradually dispersed, and Cunba also led a thousand men in abandoning his post and fleeing to Jinyang.

units.zh: 莊宗敗，為軍卒所殺。
units.en: After Zhuangzong's defeat, he was killed by common soldiers.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong was defeated, he was killed by soldiers.
